name: Timeline
description: Events on a time axis, from five sources of a ferry operator (alerts, deploys, chat, support tickets and automated agents' actions): the base layout of a view, with Filter by, Rows and Color by in the top row, the lanes Rows groups under the time range's viewfinder, the events in the range in a table with its columns' headings, and an event in the side panel with the event it answers and those that answer it.

records.name: event
records.one: one alert, deploy step, chat message, ticket message or agent action

fields.name: time
fields.how: read in UTC, a deploys.csv time without an offset as UTC+1

fields.name: kind
fields.how: firing read as fired, a ticket's first message as opened, an agent's open and close as opened and closed

fields.name: actor
fields.from: by, user, From or the agent
fields.how: a login or chat id as chat/users.json names it

fields.name: service
fields.from: svc or service, the summary, tickets/index.csv
fields.how: a missing service from the summary's first word

fields.name: severity
fields.from: severity, or a ticket's priority in tickets/index.csv
fields.how: the priority word in free text

fields.name: outcome
fields.how: ok, failed or held, other words dropped

fields.name: incident
fields.from: incident, an inc- channel or an INC number in the text
fields.how: a deploy's later steps take its incident

fields.name: answers
fields.from: resolves, deploy, thread_ts, ticket order, alert, ticket or via
fields.how: the id of the event this one answers

fields.name: took
fields.how: seconds since the event it answers

accepts.means: the event on line <n>, or the nearest event when the line holds none, opened in the side panel
a chat file's message <i>, counted from 0, the record thimble's labels mark, opened in the side panel
deploys.csv's row <n> after the header, the record thimble's labels mark, opened in the side panel

units.means: one incident's events, such as INC-312: Filter by narrowed to it and the viewfinder on its main burst of events
one day's events in UTC, the viewfinder on that day
the events between two UTC times written YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, the viewfinder on that window
